lessons_used: Predictions continue to underpredict gains on winning tests while remaining overoptimistic for non-winning tests.
Sign-in hint (6 of 13 tests) and home wait_info (3 of 9 tests) changes were helpful.
Finish new_flow changes were helpful, winning 2 of 7 tests.
Sign-in reorder changes consistently reduced performance across 2 tests.
Choose_path copy, home redesign, home new_screen, and adoption incentive changes showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for change types tested only once.

candidates.title: Interactive Custom Pet Lighting Guide Flow
candidates.change: Adds a guided photo lighting assistant component to the photo upload screen to help users capture clear pet photos.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption has the lowest step conversion rate at 66.0%.

upload_photos.hint: Ensure clear lighting and a plain background for the best custom pet result.

guard.reason: Valid addition of photo lighting guidance hint and step counter on upload photos screen.

candidates.score_note: Targets the highest dropoff step (adoption, 66%), backed by 3 support emails. adoption,new_flow has +0.4% average lift.

candidates.title: Existing Account Previous Pet Restored Safety Hint
candidates.change: Displays an explicit hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in restores existing pets and cloud saves.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in, and sign-in hints have historically won 6 of 13 tests.

sign_in.hint: Signing in automatically restores your previous desktop pet, accessories, and settings.

guard.reason: Adds reassuring account restoration hint on sign-in screen without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: High confidence intervention (sign_in, hint +2.0%, 6/13 wins) with 8 support emails, though sign-in dropoff is low.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Tray Icon Management Flow
candidates.change: Adds a component highlighting how to control, hide, or summon the pet using the desktop system tray icon on the home intro screen.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails regarding post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the pet, and finish new_flow changes won 2 of 7 past tests.

components.text: System Tray: Click pet icon to show/hide or access quick settings.

guard.reason: Adds system tray management checklist component to home_intro within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: finish, new_flow shows +1.5% historical gain (2/7 wins). Targets 19.9% finish dropoff and 3 support emails.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Asset Render Status Activity Log Display
candidates.change: Displays active rendering progress descriptions and step indicators while waiting for pet assets to assemble.
candidates.why: Home waiting stage has a long median duration of 201s (mean 2336s), and home wait_info changes have shown positive results in 3 of 9 past tests.

waiting.hint: Compiling custom pet sprites and rendering desktop behavior animations...

guard.reason: Adds detailed rendering status and progress display to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long wait time step (median 201s). home, wait_info changes consistently perform well (+1.3%, 3/9 wins).

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Interaction Hotkeys Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the home_intro screen into a split layout emphasizing keyboard shortcuts and desktop interaction controls.
candidates.why: Addresses post-onboarding confusion around controlling and summoning the desktop pet (3 support emails).

home_intro.headline: Desktop Pet Controls
home_intro.body: Use shortcut keys or right-click your pet on the desktop to interact, feed, or minimize anytime.

guard.reason: Redesigns home_intro layout to emphasize interaction controls within allowed onboarding changes.

candidates.score_note: Redesigns on finish step have performed poorly (-6.6% in past tests). High implementation cost with low expected gain.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Cloud Sync Guarantee Hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint on the adoption certificate screen guaranteeing pet traits and custom photos are backed up to the cloud.
candidates.why: 8 support emails noted fears/issues around missing pets, and adoption step dropoff is 66.0%.

adoption_certificate.hint: Your adoption certificate and pet persona are safely synced to your account cloud backup.

guard.reason: Adds cloud sync guarantee hint to adoption certificate screen.

candidates.score_note: Config-only hint on highest dropoff step (66%), but adoption hints have shown negative lift (-0.2%) in limited testing.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Background Rendering Notification Screen
candidates.change: Adds a new screen letting users know pet generation can finish safely in the background while they use their desktop.
candidates.why: The home wait stage takes median 201s / mean 2336s. Reassuring users they can minimize reduces drop-off.

new_background_render_notice.headline: Rendering in Background
new_background_render_notice.body: Your pet is building! You can minimize this window; we will alert you when your pet lands on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adds a new background rendering notice screen inside onboarding order without skipping required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens to home step has historically reduced conversion (-1.4% across 2 tests) and requires new release.

candidates.title: Path Selection Cloud Recovery Assurance Hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint explaining that path choices and unlocked companion progress sync to the account cloud.
candidates.why: Choose_path step has a long mean duration (514s); reassuring users early about account persistence reduces hesitation.

choose_path.hint: Your path selection and unlocked pets will follow your account across all desktop devices.

guard.reason: Adds cloud sync assurance hint to choose_path screen.

candidates.score_note: Easy config change addressing choose_path hesitation (mean 514s). choose_path hints yield mild positive lift (+0.4%).

candidates.title: Pick Friend Character Bio Showcase Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the pick_friend screen into a stage layout highlighting pet personality traits and animation previews.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate (66.0%) and high median time (89s). Clearer pet trait displays aid decision-making.

pick_friend.headline: Meet Your Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a desktop pet companion to view their unique personality traits and desktop animations.

guard.reason: Redesigns pick_friend layout while preserving its core pet-selection functionality.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest dropoff step (adoption), but redesigns in this area have consistently lost conversion (-0.9% across 3 tests).

candidates.title: Account Sign-In Data Preservation Safety Hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint clarifying that signing in preserves all desktop pet progress and prevents pet resets on app updates.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in, and sign-in hints are effective across past tests.

sign_in.hint: Sign in to keep your pet data safe and prevent accidental reset when updating.

guard.reason: Adds data preservation safety hint to sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Proven change type (sign_in hint, +2.0% lift) addressing 8 support emails about lost progress at minimal implementation cost.
